title: A rule whose second phase reads only the fill's knots
objective: KEEP-READ-20261118-001's first direction, given the go-ahead by the coordinator: after the first fill, take only fills whose new distinction is the middle of two or more of their knots (MID2), or more generally fills certified with at most one end knot (ONE), else subdivide. A fill makes a new crossing only through two different end knots (proved), so these rules keep the number of orders after the first fill on any base. Do they grow full two-way grids from lines and the 2 x 2 pattern, with knots on any pairs and with knots only on co-knotted pairs, well past n = 24? Serves G1 and G16; challenges A101.
stop_rule: One proof and one frozen computation with its read-out; referee hand-off; report.
